verdict.rationale: PostHog is open-source, self-hostable under MIT license, and exposes data via API, SQL/HogQL, and a documented OpenAPI spec, giving strong data-portability and self-sovereignty options. However, there's no explicit documented one-click 'export all your data' feature or standard open-format bulk export tool cited, so leaving with full data requires technical self-hosting/API work rather than a turnkey export.
